222-527-1322-6495.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-1322-6495.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Evereth twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.
222-527-1322-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

2459-3184-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Rograkh,.
Rograkh dies, triggering Yomiji, returning Rograkh from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Yahenni trigger.
Cast Rograkh by paying {0}.
Repeat.

250-779-1479-5413-7892.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-5413-7892.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of cards in hand that is above your maximum hand size.
250-779-1479-5413-7892.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Thranduil the Strategist and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Trenching Steed ability
Resolve the Thranduil the Strategist trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Thranduil the Strategist triggers.
Repeat from step 4.
Proceed to your cleanup step, and discard Dakmor Salvage and any other card(s) as needed down to your maximum hand size.
The Gitrog Monster triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat, as you will still be over your maximum hand size and will be required to discard again.

2757-4573-6705.description:
Activate Sacred Mesa by paying {1}{W}, creating two creature tokens due to Quina.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a creature token, untapping a basic Plains
Activate the Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 one additional time.
Repeat from step 1.

3129-6753-7858.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Hollowhenge Overlord triggers, creating four 2/2 Wolf creature tokens for each Wolf and/or Werewolf you control due to Primal Vigor and Exalted Sunborn.
Repeat step 1 during each of your upkeeps. You'll create exponentially more Wolves each time assuming the Wolf tokens survive.
3129-6753-7858.notes: The number of Wolves and/or Werewolves you'll control after performing steps 1 and 2 is equal to 5^X * Y, where X is the number of iterations of those steps you've performed (starting at 1), and Y is the initial number of Wolves and/or Werewolves you started with. So if you start with 6 creatures, you'll have 30 after the first iteration, 150 after the second, and so on. This also assumes no Wolves and/or Werewolves die, and no more are created during the turns.

1090-1895-6867-7183.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Restoration Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Restoration Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Restoration Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 5 or greater

620-1494-7748.description:
Deal combat damage using Ant-Man, triggering its ability, creating at least five Treasure tokens.
When the Treasures enter, Yotian Dissident triggers that many times, putting at least five +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2921-3490-4613-7426.description:
Activate Berta using Bartolomé del Presidio's ability by sacrificing a creature, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta and Animation Module trigger.
Resolve the Berta trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat

4766-6798-7361.notablePrerequisites: You control five or more Spirits.
4766-6798-7361.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Kodama.
When Kodama dies, its soulshift ability and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting Kodama from your hand onto the battlefield and attaching Deathrender to it.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

2457-4289-4742-6441.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

628-3967-7198.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Flitterwing Nuisance.
When Flitterwing Nuisance dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Yahenni ability
Repeat.

2281-6132-6798.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Saffi triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

2366-3322-4359-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-3322-4359-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nikya of the Old Ways triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

3497-4046-7070.notablePrerequisites: You've gained at least 2 life this turn.
3497-4046-7070.description:
Activate Outrider en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Outrider en-Kor.
The Outrider en-Kor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Outrider en-Kor from exile by paying {0} due to Ezzaroot Channeler.
Repeat.

1379-3259-5953-7060.easyPrerequisites: Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control.
1379-3259-5953-7060.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1379-3259-5953-7060.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Aya of Alexandria trigger.
Resolve the Aya of Alexandria trigger, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1247-2033-7008.description:
Activate Pili-Pala by tapping it, adding {G}.
Badgermole Cub triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Pili-Pala by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

549-1526-1978.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures.
549-1526-1978.description:
Activate Circle of Dreams Druid by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Circle of Dreams Druid.
Repeat

2173-4336-5220-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep
When Kobolds of Kher Keep dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Kobolds of Kher Keep from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

3293-5413-5478-5721.easyPrerequisites:
Lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{G}.
You control a Plains.
3293-5413-5478-5721.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{G}.
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all other Emeria Shepherd triggers, returning any number of nonland permanents from your graveyard to either your hand or the battlefield.
Repeat.
3293-5413-5478-5721.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard to the battlefield if you control two or more Plains. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any creature you control

3011-4090-5426.easyPrerequisites: Each opponent's life total is 2 or greater.
3011-4090-5426.description:
Cast Insult by paying {2}{R}.
Activate Heartless Hidetsugu by tapping it, dealing damage to each opponent equal to half their life total, rounded down, times 2, and dealing no damage to you due to Pariah.
3011-4090-5426.notes: If the opponents have an odd life total, they will have 1 life remaining. If they have an even life total, they will have 0 life and lose the game.

1336-2034-2178-6730.notablePrerequisites: There are at least X counters on artifacts, creatures and/or enchantments you control, where X is 4 plus the number of times you've cast Sin from the command zone this game.
1336-2034-2178-6730.description:
Cast Sin either from your hand or command zone by paying {5}{G}{U} plus commander tax if applicable.
As Sin enters, remove all counters from all artifacts, enchantments and creatures you control, putting twice that many +1/+1 counters on Sin.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Sin, adding {C}{C}.
Choose to return Sin to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Sin dies, it and Heronblade Elite trigger.
Resolve the Sin trigger, putting its counters on Heronblade Elite.
Resolve the Heronblade Elite trigger, untapping it.
Activate Heronblade Elite by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} or {U} equal to its power.
Repeat.

3967-4215-6730.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Sin.
When Sin dies, it and Verdant Succession trigger.
Resolve the Sin trigger, moving any counters from it onto another creature you control, and then shuffling Sin into your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for Sin and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.
3967-4215-6730.notes: In order to get infinite +1/+1 counters, remove as many counters as possible when Sin enters, putting twice that many +1/+1 counters on Sin as it enters. Those counters can then be moved to another creature when Sin dies.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

2713-3719-4284-5326.notablePrerequisites: Clone has a power of at least 2.
2713-3719-4284-5326.description:
Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Clone and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Clone from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Clone to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Clone enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Clone by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

4336-4452-5852.notablePrerequisites: Rukarumel on the battlefield with "Sliver" chosen
4336-4452-5852.description:
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying {0}, and choosing to pay its replicate cost an arbitrarily large number of times by paying {0}.
Kobolds of Kher Keep triggers, creating a copy of it for each time its replicate cost was paid.
Resolve all Kobolds of Kher Keep spells, causing the nontoken Kobolds of Kher Keep to enter the battlefield, and creating a token copy of it for each time its replicate cost was paid.

1284-2178-5367.notablePrerequisites:
All Equipments and/or Auras attached to the same creature.
That creature does not have summoning sickness.
1284-2178-5367.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing damage to an opponent's creature.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat until all opponents' creatures die.
Repeat each time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

703-2557-4663.description:
Cast Astral Dragon by paying {6}{U}{U}.
When Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, it and Bramble Sovereign trigger.
Resolve the Astral Dragon trigger, creating four token copies of Parallel Lives that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.
Resolve the Bramble Sovereign trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a total of 32 Astral Dragon tokens.
When the Astral Dragon tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, creating an extremely large number of Parallel Lives tokens that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.

703-1308-1622.description:
Cast Astral Dragon by paying {6}{U}{U}.
When Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, it and Minion Reflector trigger.
Resolve the Astral Dragon trigger, creating four token copies of Anointed Procession that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.
Resolve the Minion Reflector trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a total of 32 Astral Dragon tokens with haste.
When the Astral Dragon tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, creating an extremely large number of Anointed Procession tokens that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.

1479-4543-4677.notablePrerequisites: You have a land card in hand.
1479-4543-4677.description:
Play a land card from your hand.
Kodama, Trench Behemoth and Zendikar's Roil trigger.
If the land played was a basic land, you may activate it by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield from your hand.
Resolve the Trench Behemoth trigger, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
Resolve the Zendikar's Roil trigger, creating a 2/2 Elemental creature token.
The Elemental enters the battlefield, triggering Kodama.
Holding priority, activate Trench Behemoth by returning a land from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Trench Behemoth.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting a land onto the battlefield from your hand.
Trench Behemoth and Zendikar's Roil trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

639-2067-2542.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least thirty, minus one for each poison counter your opponents have and for each other creature you control.
639-2067-2542.description:
Cast Storm Herd by paying {8}{W}{W}, creating a number of 1/1 Pegasus creature tokens equal to your life total.
Cast Scapegoat by paying {W} and sacrificing a Pegasus, targeting every creature you control.
Venerated Rotpriest triggers for each creature targeted by Scapegoat.
Resolve the first trigger, causing an opponent to get a poison counter.
Repeat step 4 until an opponent loses the game due to having ten poison counters, then repeat for each other opponent.

222-232-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Saproling.
222-232-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Priest of Urabrask and Slimefoot and Squee, adding two mana in any combination of {B}, {R} or {G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Priest of Urabrask from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Urabrask and Slimefoot and Squee enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee trigger, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1580-2060-2178-4170.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Fain.
Fain does not have summoning sickness.
1580-2060-2178-4170.description:
Activate Fain's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
 Reassembling Skeleton dies, triggering Fain, untapping Fain.
Resolve the Fain ability from step 1, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two counters from it, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

796-1762-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional Zombie creature.
796-1762-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by  sacrificing a Zombie creature.
Wilhelt triggers, creating a 3/3 Zombie token with no abilities due to Poppet Factory.
Resolve the ability from step 1.
Repeat.

119-712-2757.description:
Pay {G} and sacrifice Lifespark Spellbomb, targeting the basic land.
Tap the basic land with Earthcraft, untapping itself.
Wake Thrasher triggers getting +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

719-2257-4508.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
719-2257-4508.description:
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
Reckless Fireweaver triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, as Reckless Fireweaver is a Pirate due to Xenograft, creating a Treasure token for each opponent dealt damage this way.
When the Treasure(s) enter, Reckless Fireweaver triggers that many times.
Resolve the first Reckless Fireweaver trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

2265-4929-5189.notablePrerequisites: Cryptic Trilobite has at least three +1/+1 counters.
2265-4929-5189.description:
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from Cryptic Trilobite, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Saproling token, putting two +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite.
Repeat.

4050-5003-5296.description:
Activate Workhorse by removing four +1/+1 counters, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Workhorse, adding one mana of any color.
Workhorse dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Workhorse from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Workhorse enters the battlefield with four +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.
